title: Capture portable chronicle facts on campaign release
description: On sync-back/release, derive or accept character-scoped subjective memories from the campaign session/arc material without copying campaign world canon wholesale. Store only explicitly character-scoped facts/events in the CharacterChronicle with campaign/session provenance.
acceptance_criteria: Release/sync-back can append chronicle records for the linked global character; objective campaign bible/world facts are not copied automatically; tests prove campaign canon remains campaign-local while selected character-scoped records travel.
notes: PR #348 updated after re-review: chronicle validation now reserves final generated IDs before release sync-back and generated IDs skip existing caller-supplied sequence IDs such as chronicle-2. Added store and release regressions for that path. Verification: npm run verify:worktree.
